name: synthetic-search-free-ok
description: SYNTHETIC happy chain for clawifi#search/free. Body is a real 2026-10-23 response from Clawifi's keyless POST /playground/run (operation 'search', query 'example domain iana'), whose `result` is the /search/free response model: trimmed to 2 rows (result_count adjusted) with each row's engine `data` cut to five keys. `credits_charged: 1` is added as Clawifi 1.7.5 returns it when the request carries `X-Clawifi-Include-Credits: 1` (every 2xx search costs 1). Replace via `deno task record` when CLAWIFI_API_KEY exists.
